summary: Vaso Corp filed an 8-K reporting the sale of its wholly owned subsidiary NetWolves Network Services LLC to COEO Solutions, LLC. Under the Equity Purchase Agreement dated July 31, 2026, the buyer acquired all outstanding membership interests for a base cash purchase price of $14.5 million, subject to customary post-closing adjustments for net working capital, cash, indebtedness, and seller expenses. The transaction represents a divestiture of a managed network provider business. No advisors or board recommendation were disclosed. The agreement is filed as Exhibit 10.1. Watch for closing conditions and any regulatory approvals or post-closing adjustment disputes.
